name: dev.workers.mnpi.prayer-times/prayer-times
title: Prayer times and sun times
description: Islamic prayer times (20+ methods) and sunrise/sunset for 34,000 towns or coordinates, local time.

tools.name: prayer_times
tools.description: Prayer times (imsak, fajr, sunrise, dhuhr, asr, maghrib, isha, midnight) for a town, city or coordinates, in local time, for one day or a timetable of up to 31 days. Covers 34,000 towns worldwide (names in English or Arabic). Calculation method defaults to the usual one for the country (Umm al-Qura in Saudi Arabia, Egyptian in Egypt, Karachi in Pakistan, ISNA in North America, MWL elsewhere) and is always stated; asr standard or hanafi.

place.description: Town or city name, optionally with country: "Riyadh", "Birmingham, UK", "القاهرة". Or use latitude/longitude.

country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code or country name to pick among same-named towns.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for coordinates, e.g. "Europe/London". Default: from the nearest town.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; default today in the place's timezone.

asr.description: Asr juristic method; default standard (hanafi in PK, IN, BD, AF).

days.description: Number of days from date (timetable). Default 1.

tools.name: sun_times
tools.description: Sunrise, sunset, solar noon, day length, and civil, nautical and astronomical dawn and dusk for a town, city or coordinates on a date, in local time.

place.description: Town or city name, optionally with country: "Riyadh", "Birmingham, UK", "القاهرة". Or use latitude/longitude.

country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code or country name to pick among same-named towns.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for coordinates, e.g. "Europe/London". Default: from the nearest town.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; default today in the place's timezone.

tools.name: prayer_methods
tools.description: The calculation methods available (fajr and isha angles), and the countries where each is the default.
